name: Corgi ETF Trust I - RIVN 2x Daily ETF
name_en: Corgi ETF Trust I - RIVN 2x Daily ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that, under ordinary market conditions, seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of Rivian Automotive, Inc. ("Rivian"). It is non-diversified.
